mandarin-oriental-riverside-bangkok.title: Mandarin Oriental Bangkok | Sculptural Lighting
mandarin-oriental-riverside-bangkok.description: Sculptural chandeliers and flower-shaped wall lights by Francesco Cappuccio for Mandarin Oriental, Bangkok. Explore the original lighting images and design drawings.

deco.title: Deco | Decorative Path Lighting
deco.description: Deco path lighting by Francesco Cappuccio casts decorative shadows across garden walkways and walls. View the original lighting study and detail images.

harvest.title: Harvest | SOMA Riverside Hotel Light Sculpture
harvest.description: Harvest by Francesco Cappuccio is a sculptural light installation for SOMA Riverside Hotel, Phnom Penh, inspired by fishing nets and the ocean. View the project images.

bloom.title: Bloom | Floral Sculptural Chandelier
bloom.description: Bloom by Francesco Cappuccio is a floral sculptural chandelier with illuminated petals. Explore the original daylight and evening views of the light sculpture.

cinque-terre.title: Cinque Terre | Portable Lamp Collection
cinque-terre.description: Cinque Terre portable lamps by Francesco Cappuccio draw on the colors and coastal villages of Liguria. Explore the five-lamp collection, installation images and sketches.

scacco-matto.title: Scacco Matto | Modular Portable Lamp
scacco-matto.description: Scacco Matto by Francesco Cappuccio for Lumere is a modular portable lamp with three magnetic elements and five light-sculpture configurations. Photography: Gaetano Del Mauro.

damansara.title: The Pavilion Crown | Pavilion Damansara Heights Lighting
damansara.description: The Pavilion Crown by Francesco Cappuccio combines a geometric illuminated facade and drop-off canopy at Pavilion Damansara Heights Mall, Kuala Lumpur. View the project gallery.

home-collection-2026.title: Home Collection 2026 | Furniture Preview
home-collection-2026.description: Francesco Cappuccio's Home Collection 2026 preview features sculptural seating and furniture studies. Explore the original armchair, sofa and lounge-chair images.

framed.title: Framed | Sculptural Lighting Installation
framed.description: Framed by Francesco Cappuccio is a sculptural lighting installation for Sarath Ratanavadi in Bangkok. View the completed chandelier, workshop process and installation images.

original-sin.title: Original Sin | Collaborative Art Installation
original-sin.description: Original Sin is a collaborative art installation by Alexi Silk, Francesco Cappuccio and Grant Gramezy in Bangkok. Explore images of the sculptural triptych and its details.

hill-bench-storage.title: Hill | Two-in-One Bench and Shoe Storage
hill-bench-storage.description: Hill by Francesco Cappuccio combines a bench with an angled shoe-storage rack in steel. View the original furniture design, perforated storage surface and construction details.

akuna-lighting-experience.title: Akuna | Le Meridien Saigon Restaurant Lighting
akuna-lighting-experience.description: Akuna lighting by Francesco Cappuccio for Le Meridien Saigon layers glass, light and shadow in a restaurant interior. Explore the original lighting and installation images.

wai.title: WAI | Sofitel Sculptural Chandelier
wai.description: WAI by Francesco Cappuccio for Sofitel translates the Thai greeting into steel petals and handcrafted recycled-glass droplets. Explore the sculptural chandelier and detail images.

gio.title: GIO | Glass Orb Wall Lamp
gio.description: GIO by Francesco Cappuccio is a wall lamp inspired by Gio Ponti, combining frosted glass orbs and a geometric metal base. View the original product and installation images.

quadra.title: Quadra | Murano Glass Lighting at Stonehill
quadra.description: Quadra lighting by Francesco Cappuccio pairs geometric metal frames and engraved Murano glass at Stonehill Golf Club, Bangkok. Explore pendant, wall-light and interior images.

amsterdam.title: Amsterdam | Polycarbonate Chandelier
amsterdam.description: Amsterdam by Francesco Cappuccio is a polycarbonate chandelier inspired by glowing canal-house windows. Explore the original lighting images and the credited city reference.

metro.title: Metro | Checker-Plate Bench and Stool Collection
metro.description: Metro by Francesco Cappuccio is a bench and stool collection defined by checker-plate surfaces, geometric panels and color. Explore the original furniture images and details.

nexum.title: Nexum | Sculptural Coffee Table for Vertier
nexum.description: Nexum is a sculptural coffee table designed by Francesco Cappuccio for Vertier, with a flowing top and paired rounded bases. View product and detail photographs credited to Vertier.

hinge.title: HINGE | Glass, Marble and Steel Coffee Table
hinge.description: HINGE is a coffee table designed by Francesco Cappuccio for Vertier, exposing its folded steel, hinge connections, marble and glass. View photographs credited to Vertier.

aries-sofa.title: Aries Sofa | Sculptural Upholstered Seating
aries-sofa.description: Aries Sofa by Francesco Cappuccio combines rounded sculptural forms and deep textured upholstery. Explore the original sofa image and its Aries-inspired design concept.
